subtitle: A Battle Remembered, A History Questioned

panels.shot: epic split composition, half showing a hazy medieval battlefield, half showing a crowded dargah courtyard centuries later
panels.action: Suheldev of Bahraich and Ghazi Miyan stand back to back in ghostly outline over a misty plain, while below them, pilgrims throng the white domes of Bahraich dargah under a blazing sky.

dialogue.text: At Bahraich, a saint’s shrine and a warrior’s legend guard a battle no one saw, yet millions remember.

i18n.hi: बहराइच में, एक सूफ़ी दरगाह और एक योद्धा की कथा उस जंग की रखवाली करती है, जो किसी ने देखी नहीं, पर लाखों याद करते हैं।

panels.shot: wide aerial over the Sarayu-Ghaghara basin at dawn
panels.action: Mist curls above braided rivers and dark green forests of the Sarayu-Ghaghara basin, as faint tracks and tiny hamlets dot the wet, fertile plain under a pale rising sun.

dialogue.text: In the early eleventh century, where the Sarayu meets the Ghaghara, quiet villages watched the horizon with unease.

i18n.hi: ग्यारहवीं सदी की शुरुआत में, जहाँ सरयू घाघरा से मिलती है, शांत गाँव डरते‑डरते क्षितिज निहारते थे।

panels.shot: slow push-in on a caravan of armed horsemen silhouetted against the light
panels.action: A line of mailed horsemen with tall spears rides along a dusty track, their banners fluttering, distant and indistinct against the shimmering plain.

dialogue.text: From the northwest, Ghaznavid-linked armies probed the Gangetic plain, their campaigns reaching as far as the Sarayu basin.

i18n.hi: उत्तरी‑पश्चिम से ग़ज़नवी जुड़ी सेनाएँ गङ्गा के मैदानी इलाक़े टटोलती बढ़ीं, उनके अभियान सरयू तक पहुँच गए।

panels.shot: medium shot of Ghazi Miyan in armor, contemplative, overlooking a riverbank camp
panels.action: Ghazi Miyan stands in partial armor beside the wide river, one hand resting on a spear, watching tents and soldiers setting up a camp along the muddy bank.

dialogue.text: Later memory would name one such figure Salar Masud, Ghazi Miyan, a young warrior-saint whose path turned toward Bahraich.

i18n.hi: बाद की यादों ने ऐसे ही एक सिपहसालार को नाम दिया – सालार मसूद, ग़ाज़ी मियाँ, जर्जर उम्र का जवान सूफ़ी‑योद्धा, जिसकी राह बहराइच की तरफ़ मुड़ गई।

panels.shot: shadowed interior of a later-period study, candle-lit, with Mirat-i-Masudi manuscript on a low desk
panels.action: An unseen scholar’s hands, in 17th-century dress, gently open a freshly copied Persian manuscript, its pages neat and dense in black script under the warm glow of a small oil lamp.

dialogue.text: Yet our main tale of Masud and his foe Suheldev comes not from that age, but from Mirat-i-Masudi, written nearly six centuries later.

i18n.hi: पर मसूद और उसके दुश्मन सुहेलदेव की हमारी कहानी उस ज़माने से नहीं, बाद की किताब ‘मीरात‑ए‑मसूदी’ से निकलती है, जो क़रीब छह सौ साल बाद लिखी गई।

panels.shot: close-up on the manuscript page as if seen by the reader
panels.action: The open page shows flowing Persian lines; a faint phantom image of Suheldev facing Ghazi Miyan seems to rise from the ink, hovering lightly over the script.

dialogue.text: Abd-ur-Rahman Chishti’s Mirat-i-Masudi mixes devotion and story, raising more questions for historians than it answers.

i18n.hi: अबदुर्रहमान चिश्ती की ‘मीरात‑ए‑मसूदी’ भक्ति और किस्सा मिलाती है, इतिहासकारों के लिए जवाब से ज़्यादा सवाल छोड़ जाती है।

panels.shot: dramatic low-angle of Suheldev on a ridge, but rendered slightly hazy, as if seen through memory
panels.action: Suheldev stands on a low ridge, hand on the hilt of his sword, looking over fields and tree-lines, his figure strong yet edged in soft, dreamlike mist.

dialogue.text: The text sings of Suheldev, a local chief who rallies resistance at Bahraich, but outside its pages, he is all but silent.

i18n.hi: किताब सुहेलदेव को गाती है – बहराइच का मुखिया, जो मोर्चा जमाता है – पर किताब के बाहर उसका नाम मुश्किल से ही सुनाई देता है।

panels.shot: medium frontal of Suheldev in council with indistinct local leaders around a fire
panels.action: Suheldev sits by a low campfire with several shadowed figures representing local chiefs, their outlines blurred, faces indistinct, as if the scene refuses to come fully into focus.

dialogue.text: The Mirat paints alliances, numbers, grand coalitions, yet no contemporary inscription, no chronicle, repeats these details.

i18n.hi: मीरात में गठजोड़, फ़ौजें, बड़ी‑बड़ी जोड़ियाँ हैं, मगर कोई समकालीन शिलालेख, कोई तवारीख इन बातों को दोहराती नहीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of opposing camps on either side of a marshy field near Bahraich
panels.action: On one side of a marsh-fringed clearing stand rough wooden palisades and clustered huts; on the other side, lines of tents and tethered horses, facing each other across low fog.

dialogue.text: Still, tradition insists: near Bahraich, two forces met, a frontier clash that, if real, checked further Ghaznavid-linked advance here.

i18n.hi: फिर भी परंपरा अड़ी है – बहराइच के पास दो सेनाएँ भिड़ीं, ऐसा सरहदी संग्राम, जिसने अगर सच में हुआ, तो यहाँ ग़ज़नवी बढ़त को रोक दिया।

panels.shot: tense pre-battle wide shot, but with no combat depicted, only poised stillness
panels.action: Rank upon rank of warriors stand poised with spears lowered, dust hanging in the air, faces tight with anticipation as birds rise from the grass in a sudden flutter.

dialogue.speaker: suheldev_and_salar_masud
dialogue.text: What we do here will echo far beyond this field.

i18n.hi: जो हम यहाँ करेंगे, उसकी गूँज इस मैदान से बहुत दूर तक जाएगी।

panels.shot: stylized overhead view of the battlefield as flowing lines and arrows on old paper
panels.action: The battlefield now appears as a faded map drawn on parchment, with ghostly arrows and formations sketched in, some dark and clear, others smudged and broken off.

dialogue.text: Mirat-i-Masudi describes tactics, ambushes, heroic charges, yet historians step carefully, for no eyewitness record survives.

i18n.hi: मीरात‑ए‑मसूदी चालें, घात, दिलेर धावे दिखाती है, पर इतिहासकार पाँव फूँक‑फूँक कर रखते हैं, क्योंकि कोई आँखों‑देखा बयान बचा ही नहीं।

panels.shot: poised mid-action tableau of Suheldev and Ghazi Miyan riding toward each other, but frozen
panels.action: Suheldev and Ghazi Miyan ride their horses toward one another across uneven ground, lances angled, expressions resolute, time itself seemingly frozen at the verge of impact.

dialogue.text: The hagiography crowns Suheldev as victor and Masud as martyred saint; the field becomes both battlefield and birth-place of a shrine.

i18n.hi: इस मनाक़़िब में सुहेलदेव को फ़तह का ताज मिलता है और मसूद शहीद औलिया बनता है; यह मैदान एक साथ मيدان‑ए‑जंग और दरगाह की ज़मीन बन उठता है।

panels.shot: gentle wide shot of a simple 11th-century grave mound beside the riverbank
panels.action: On a quiet riverbank, a low earthen mound covered with stones and a few cloth offerings lies under a lone tree, while the river glints and flows past in the background.

dialogue.text: Somewhere here, perhaps, a grave was raised for a fallen warrior, and over time that grave drew stories like iron draws filings.

i18n.hi: कहीं यहीं, शायद, किसी गिरे योद्धा की क़ब्र उठी, और वक़्त के साथ उस क़ब्र ने क़िस्से ऐसे खींचे जैसे लोहा चुंबक की तरफ़।

panels.shot: transition shot, grave mound slowly morphing into a white-domed dargah
panels.action: The simple mound gradually transforms into a gleaming white-domed dargah in the same spot, walls rising, courtyards forming, while the lone tree spreads wider branches around it.

dialogue.text: Centuries passed. Around that memory a dargah grew, Ghazi Miyan’s shrine at Bahraich, more solid than any battle narrative.

i18n.hi: सदियाँ बीतीं। उसी याद के चारों ओर एक दरगाह उग आई – बहराइच की ग़ाज़ी मियाँ की मज़ार, किसी भी जंग की कहानी से ज़्यादा ठोस।

panels.shot: bustling courtyard scene at Bahraich dargah in the early modern period
panels.action: Men and women from different communities throng the dargah courtyard, some tying threads to railings, others sharing food, musicians playing in a corner as the dome rises serene above them.

dialogue.text: Pilgrims came from many castes and faiths, seeking blessing from Ghazi Miyan, weaving their own needs and hopes into his story.

i18n.hi: कई जातों और मज़हबों से ज़ायरीन आए, ग़ाज़ी मियाँ से दुआ लेने, और अपनी ज़रूरतें, अपनी उम्मीदें उनकी दास्तान में पिरोते गए।

panels.shot: medium shot of a mother with a child at the dargah, offering a small toy horse
panels.action: A village mother lifts her child toward the shrine railing, helping tiny hands place a painted clay horse among many similar offerings lining the ledge.

dialogue.speaker: suheldev_and_salar_masud
dialogue.text: Ride with my child, Ghazi Miyan, and keep him safe.

i18n.hi: मेरे बच्चे के साथ सवार हो, ग़ाज़ी मियाँ, और उसे हिफ़ाज़त में रखना।

panels.shot: study-lined room in the 20th century, Shahid Amin at a desk with books and field notes
panels.action: A modern historian sits at a desk cluttered with notebooks and printed reports, a map of eastern Uttar Pradesh pinned behind him, as he pores over a copy of Mirat-i-Masudi.

dialogue.text: Shahid Amin would later trace how this warrior-saint’s cult grew, changed, and spoke differently to each age that visited Bahraich.

i18n.hi: शाहिद अमीन ने बाद में देखा‑परखा कि इस सूफ़ी‑योद्धा का कल्ट कैसे फैला, बदला, और हर ज़माने से बहराइच आकर अलग तरह बात करता रहा।

panels.shot: split-panel feel within one frame: on one side pilgrims at the shrine, on the other side modern political rally invoking Suheldev
panels.action: On the left, devotees circle the dargah with quiet reverence; on the right, leaders stand on a decorated stage before a crowd, holding up images of Suheldev and speaking into raised microphones.

dialogue.text: Elsewhere, Suheldev’s name rose again, invoked in new debates, as if the uncertain battle had become a mirror for modern anxieties.

i18n.hi: कहीं और, सुहेलदेव का नाम फिर उभरा, नई बहसों में पुकारा गया, जैसे वह धुँधली जंग अब नए ज़माने की घबराहटों का आईना बन गई हो।

panels.shot: close-up on a weathered stone at the dargah courtyard with pilgrims’ hands touching it
panels.action: Several hands of different ages and adornments rest lightly on an old stone in the dargah courtyard, sunlight and shadow playing over the worn surface.

dialogue.text: The shrine is real stone, the hagiography a crafted tale; between them lies a shared memory that no single group owns.

i18n.hi: दरगाह पत्थर की है, मनाक़़िब बुनी हुई कहानी; इनके बीच एक साझी याद है, जिसे कोई एक जमात अपना नहीं कह सकती।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide shot of the dargah at sunset, Suheldev and Ghazi Miyan as faint silhouettes above
panels.action: The Bahraich dargah glows in the orange of sunset, its dome outlined against the sky, while faint translucent figures of Suheldev and Ghazi Miyan stand above, watching the river and town below.

dialogue.text: We may never fix every step of Suheldev or Ghazi Miyan, yet their intertwined legend shows how people shape the past to make sense of their present.

i18n.hi: हम शायद कभी सुहेलदेव या ग़ाज़ी मियाँ के हर क़दम को नहीं जोड़ पाएँगे, पर उनकी जुड़ी हुई दास्तान दिखाती है कि लोग अपने आज को समझने के लिए अतीत को कैसे गढ़ते हैं।

subtitle_i18n.en: A Battle Remembered, A History Questioned
